summary: You act on the spark. Drive and the urge to break form are fused, so you move fast, hate being told what to do, and can upend a situation before you've thought it through. Impulse is your default speed.
body: You act on the spark. Drive and the urge to break form are fused, so you move fast, hate being told what to do, and can upend a situation before you've thought it through. Impulse is your default speed. You're bold, original in action, the one who'll try what others won't, and also the one who acts rashly, picks fights with authority, or blows something up just to feel free. The shadow is reckless, sometimes literally, accident-prone when the energy outruns the judgment. Aim the impulse and you become a genuine maverick instead of a loose cannon.
gift: At your best: bold, original, the one who acts when others hesitate.
shadow: The trap: acting rashly, picking fights with authority, blowing things up to feel free.
integration: Let drive and anger and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Innovative and fast; the cost is recklessness and volatility.
do: Put a beat between the spark and the act
Aim the impulse at something worth it
dont: Pick fights with authority for sport
Blow things up to feel free
